entities.summary: Timothy Scott Baker is an American former professional baseball player. A starting pitcher, he played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Minnesota Twins, Chicago Cubs, Texas Rangers and Los Angeles Dodgers. He bats and throws right-handed.
